title: The Effects of Gender-Affirming Hormone Therapy on Exercise Performance, Health Related Markers and Lived Experiences of Trans* Athletes – A Longitudinal Case Study
summary: This study examines the impact of gender-affirming hormone therapy on strength and endurance performance, as well as on objective performance- and health-related markers—including body composition, metabolic markers, and hormonal, hematological, immunological, and inflammatory markers—in trained trans men and trans women. In addition, the study will examine the experiences of trained trans men and trans women with their medical transition within the tension between physical performance, athletic identity, and social integration. Laboratory tests will be conducted at regular intervals shortly before the start of hormone therapy and over a one-year period following the initiation of hormone therapy.
conditions: Gender-affirming hormone therapy in trained trans women and trans men

interventions.name: Gender-affirming hormone therapy in trained trans women and trans men

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
trans men or trans women, non-smoker, no chronic or acute injuries, trained (exercises more than 3 times a week), planned initiation of a gender-affirming hormone therapy independetly from the study
Exclusion criteria:
Individuals who have already undergone gender-affirming surgery, have previously received GAHT, or have used puberty blockers will be excluded.
